name: Dittofeed

evidence.marketing: F02: user journeys with waits, delays and segment splits
evidence.newsletter: F02: broadcasts send one-off newsletters and announcements to a segment
evidence.multichannel: F02: messaging across email, SMS, mobile push, WhatsApp and Slack, triggered by user events (F21)

line: Self-host customer messaging journeys and newsletters across email and other channels.

free.text: Free MIT software; you provide hosting and email delivery

cells.api: Yes, REST API and event SDKs
